description: This file contains API functions for fetching user-related data, including user projects and basic user info, from a backend service. It exports two asynchronous functions: getUserProjects and getUserBasic.

methods.name: getUserProjects
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from session tracking using the backend endpoint, with support for query parameters such as tenant ID and date range.

methods.name: getUserBasic
methods.description: Fetches minimal user information by MongoDB ObjectId, handling 404 errors gracefully.
